name: apple-calendar-mcp
description: Read, create, update and delete Apple Calendar events on macOS, and find free time.
long_description: An MCP server for Apple Calendar. A notarized helper talks to EventKit and is the only process that needs calendar access; macOS asks for it once, under the name calendar-helper, and the grant survives updates. Recurring events come back as individual occurrences. find_free_time returns open gaps for work or personal time, with optional buffers around meetings. create_event, update_event and delete_event change your calendar; there is no undo.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: Lists the calendars configured in macOS Calendar, with id, title, type and whether they can be changed.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Reads events in a date range, with recurring events as individual occurrences and optional text search.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Creates an event with title, time or all-day dates, location, notes and alarms.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Changes an existing event; for a recurring event, one occurrence or that one and all later ones.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Deletes an event; for a recurring event, one occurrence or that one and all later ones. There is no undo.

tools.name: find_free_time
tools.description: Finds free slots of a given length for work or personal time, optionally with buffers around meetings.
